intent_definitions.description: Where is my order / delivery is late, missing, or tracking shows wrong status.
Customer wants a refund, wants to return an item, or asks about cancellation of an order.
Item arrived damaged, defective, wrong item, or not working as advertised.
Can't log in, account locked/suspended, password, or account-security issue.
Charged incorrectly, double charge, payment method failed, billing/invoice question.
App, website, or streaming (Prime Video/Music/Kindle) technical error or bug.
Pre-purchase or general question about a product, price, promotion, or availability.
Customer is expressing frustration / complaint about service quality without one specific actionable request above.
Doesn't clearly match any of the above, or is too short/ambiguous to classify.
